emptyState.heading: Ask the analyst
emptyState.subline: It reads Chicago's municipal code and cites the sections. Ask about the code — or about any parcel you've opened.
examples: What are the setback requirements for B3-2 zoning?
What uses are allowed in a C1-2 district?
When does a rear addition need a zoning variance?

crossref.unavailable: Full text not available for this reference.
crossref.notCodified: Not in the published code text yet; an amendment added it.

sinceThen.rebuilt: details rebuilt from the saved answer
sinceThen.partial: rechecked today: no change in what we could read (couldn't re-check {{what}})
sinceThen.heading: Since this answer ({{date}}):

district.plain: the City's map now shows {{new}}, not {{old}}.
district.withRecord: the City's map now shows {{new}}, not {{old}} (Ordinance {{record}}, passed {{date}}).

overlay.added: the City's map now shows {{layer}} here.
overlay.addedNamed: the City's map now shows {{layer}} here ({{name}}).
overlay.removed: the City's map no longer shows {{layer}} here.

amendment.after: Council passed {{record}} on {{date}}; it amends {{sections}}, which this answer cited.
amendment.before: {{record}}, passed {{date}}, amends {{sections}}, which this answer cited; the code text it used did not include that change.

sinceThen.mapAmendment: a rezoning ordinance listing this address has passed ({{record}}, {{date}}) and is not on the City's zoning map yet.
sinceThen.designation: a Chicago Landmark designation listing this address has passed ({{record}}, {{date}}) and is not on the City's landmark map yet.
sinceThen.textRefresh: the code text was updated through {{date}}, and {{sections}} changed.
